description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a large light pink pillow fills the view, and a white T‑shirt is laid out on the mattress. The left hand and right hand reach in and grasp the shirt, spreading it flatter, then both hands fold it by bringing the bottom edge up toward the middle; the hands then smooth and tuck the fabric, with the left hand lifting and adjusting a sleeve while the right hand steadies the folded section.
